name: browser
title: Browser window for real recordings
description: Browser window that shows real screen recordings or screenshots (anim.py record/grab), with only the domain in the address bar and a zoom to the important part.

name: cards-3d
title: 3D card stack
description: Three thick choice cards fan out and the chosen card comes forward.

name: chat
title: Chat screen (rebuilt, no logo)
description: Rebuilt chat screen with an empty state, typing in the input field, sending, a streaming answer, strike-through and highlight; variants dark (ChatGPT-like), light (Claude-like) and mobile.

name: checklist
title: Checklist (ticks)
description: Row of accent labels with a check mark that appear one by one; shows that requirements or steps are met.

name: core
title: Core helpers (timing, typing, streaming)
description: Timing on the voice, show and hide, snap-ins, typing letter by letter, streaming words in and showing spoken words one by one; every other block uses this.

name: cube-3d
title: 3D cube transition
description: One cube with two content faces turns left to the next scene.

name: cursor
title: Cursor with click
description: Big mouse cursor that moves to a button and clicks, with a click ring; the click starts the next step.

name: end-card
title: Wordmark end card
description: Crosshair mark with a wordmark that snaps in from the left at the end and stays until the video stops.

name: panel
title: Full-screen panel (transition)
description: Accent panel that slides in from the right over everything with big lines, then leaves to the left; a hard transition to a new part.

name: phone
title: Phone frame
description: Phone with an ink-coloured body, notch and hard shadow; the screen is the place for another block, such as the chat screen in the mobile variant.

name: prompt-layers-3d
title: 3D prompt layers
description: Role, task, example and rules separate in Z and click together into one prompt card.

name: room-3d
title: 3D geometry helper
description: Shared physical faces, drawings, camera container and hard shadow for the 3D blocks.

name: stamp
title: Stamp with shake
description: Tilted stamp that lands on the picture with a bang and a short shake of the screen under it; for the turning point or a verdict.

name: tip
title: Numbered tip block
description: Accent block with a big number and a title that comes in word by word with the voice; enters from the right and leaves to the left.

name: chatgpt-chat
title: Recording: ChatGPT, one prompt and the answer
description: Steps file that types one prompt in ChatGPT and records the answer, only the conversation column (crop), with a privacy scan.

name: claude-chat
title: Recording: Claude, one prompt and the answer
description: Steps file that types one prompt in Claude and records the answer, only the conversation column (crop), with a privacy scan.

name: animated-noise-grain
title: Animated noise grain
description: Film grain laid over the whole frame on a canvas; the pattern changes every second frame and is the same on every seek. Use it to take the clean digital look off a scene.

name: arrow-annotate
title: Arrow annotate
description: A hand-drawn arrow draws itself from a point to a target element, with an optional label; use it to tell the viewer where to look.

name: blinds
title: Blinds
description: Slats open one after the other, each sweeping sideways or down, and show the next full-frame shot; use it for a rhythmic, graphic scene change (cut K5 variant).

name: blur-reveal
title: Blur reveal
description: Text rises 16 px out of a soft blur and fades in on a calm spring with no overshoot; the default reveal for a title or a line.

name: callout
title: Callout
description: A label box lands next to one spot, then a line draws from the box to that spot; use it to name a part of the picture.

name: camera-shake
title: Camera shake
description: One short shake of the whole scene that fades to rest by itself; use it for an impact, a hit or a slam, not as idle motion.

name: circle-reveal
title: Circle reveal
description: A round hole opens from any point of the frame and shows the next full-frame shot, led by a strip of its ground colour; use it for a clean, deliberate scene change (cut K5).

name: code-block
title: Code block
description: A code window with syntax colours where the code types itself character by character or appears line by line; use it to show a snippet.

name: comparison-bars
title: Comparison bars
description: Rows of two bars, a muted before and a coloured after, that grow in turn with counting numbers and a change chip; use it for a before/after or old/new comparison.

name: connector-lines
title: Connector lines
description: Lines draw between named anchors or boxes, one after the other, with a dot where each one lands; use it for flows, diagrams and relations.

name: device-pullback
title: Device pullback
description: The outgoing shot starts at about 3x, pulls back slowly, then snaps in one frame into a laptop or phone frame; use it for the beat 'this is inside the real product' (cut K6).

name: donut-chart
title: Donut chart
description: A multi-segment donut whose slices sweep on clockwise one after another while the total counts in the hole and a legend lists each part; use it to show how a whole splits.

name: dynamic-grid
title: Dynamic grid
description: A technical grid of lines or dots drifts diagonally and loops by one cell; a calm full-frame backdrop for data, dev and dashboard scenes.

name: expand-morph
title: Expand morph
description: A rounded card of the next shot grows from a small origin rect to the full frame while the old shot leans back; use it when a box, input or list becomes its result (cut K3).

name: funnel-chart
title: Funnel chart
description: Stage bands wipe in from the top and narrow toward the bottom, with counting numbers and the drop-off percent between bands; use it for a conversion or a step-by-step loss.

name: gauge-dial
title: Gauge dial
description: A dial arc fills and a needle sweeps to a target while the readout counts up under it; use it for one score, rate or level against a known range.

name: grid-pixelate
title: Grid pixelate
description: Square cells of the next shot's ground colour fill the frame in a seeded scatter, the shots swap under them, then the cells clear; a retro, high-energy cut between two scenes (cut K5 variant).

name: handwriting-text
title: Handwriting text
description: Writes a line of text on letter by letter, left to right, with a pen dot on the wet edge and an optional hand-drawn underline; use it for a personal note, a title or a signature feel.

name: ken-burns
title: Ken burns
description: A slow, steady zoom and pan over any element, usually a picture; the documentary move for a still image.

name: line-chart
title: Line chart
description: A line draws on left to right over a soft area with dots that pop as the line reaches them and the last value shown at its end; use it for one trend over time.

name: marker-highlight
title: Marker highlight
description: A highlighter stroke sweeps word by word across a phrase, as marker, knockout, underline or box; use it to stress the key words of a line.

name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: A seamless band of words that scrolls sideways at a steady speed, with an accent dot between words; use it for a ticker row or a list of topics behind the voice.

name: mask-reveal
title: Mask reveal
description: Text is uncovered by a mask that slides away with a hard, sharp edge and no fade; use it for a title that should arrive with authority.

name: masked-slide-reveal
title: Masked slide reveal
description: Words or lines slide up out of a line mask one after another; use it for a headline that builds word by word.

name: matrix-decode
title: Matrix decode
description: Random glyphs resolve from left to right into the real text, with one accent character on the decode front; use it for a data, code or reveal moment.

name: mesh-gradient
title: Mesh gradient
description: Soft blobs of brand colour drift slowly behind a scene; a quiet atmosphere layer for a full-frame backdrop, never the subject.

name: motion-trail
title: Motion trail
description: An element flies in from the side and leaves a trail of fading, blurred echoes behind it; use it for a fast, energetic arrival.

name: notification-stack
title: Notification stack
description: Generic toast notifications slide in, stack in a corner and dismiss themselves while the others close the gap; use it for alerts or activity.

name: orbit-motion
title: Ormotion
description: The children of an element travel round a tilted ellipse with depth (bigger and brighter in front); use it for a set of items around a central idea.

name: particle-field
title: Particle field
description: Glowing dots drift across the frame with depth: near dots are bigger, faster and brighter. A calm backdrop under a whole scene.

name: pie-reveal
title: Pie reveal
description: A single ring fills clockwise from 12 o'clock to a percent while the big number in its middle counts up; use it for one share or score.

name: progress-bar
title: Progress bar
description: A pill-shaped bar fills from 0 to a value while the number above it counts up in step; use it for one percentage or score that the voice names.

name: rgb-glitch-text
title: Rgb glitch text
description: Two colour copies ride just off the text and burst wider now and then, then the text settles clean; a short high-energy hit for a title.

name: rotate-in
title: Rotate in
description: Text settles from a slight tilt (default -8 degrees) to straight while it fades in, on a calm spring with no overshoot; use it for a title or a line.

name: shake-emphasis
title: Shake emphasis
description: A short impact shake that dies away, with a small squash on the hit; use it on a word or card on the beat the voice stresses.

name: shimmer-sweep
title: Shimmer sweep
description: A single band of accent colour sweeps once (or a few times) across the text without moving the layout; a restrained emphasis for a key phrase.

name: skew-in
title: Skew in
description: An element slides in sideways while leaning, then stands up straight; an editorial entrance for a headline or a panel.

name: slot-roll
title: Slot roll
description: Each character spins through a reel of glyphs and lands on the new character, column by column; use it for a number or a code that changes.

name: sparkline-row
title: Sparkline row
description: A stack of rows, each with a label, a small trend line that draws on, a counting headline value and a change figure; use it for a quick read of several metrics at once.

name: spotlight
title: Spotlight
description: Dims everything in an element except one circle or rounded rectangle, with an accent ring on the edge; the light can move on and switch off.

name: spring-in
title: Spring in
description: An element scales up a little and rises into place on a spring, with snappy, smooth and bouncy presets; use it for a card, a label or any block that arrives.

name: stat-card
title: Stat card
description: A big number counts up above its label, and an accent rule draws under both; use it for a hero stat, a milestone or a result.

name: strikethrough-replace
title: Strikethrough replace
description: A line strikes out one phrase, holds a beat, then a new phrase replaces it in a single frame (cut K10); use it for a correction or a before and after.

name: stroke-to-fill-text
title: Stroke to fill text
description: Letters appear as an outline and then a solid fill floods each letter from the bottom up; use it for a bold title with a build-up.

name: svg-mask-reveal
title: Svg mask reveal
description: An SVG shape (circle, star, heart, your own path) grows from a point and uncovers an element; use it for a shape-led reveal of a scene or a picture.

name: terminal
title: Terminal
description: A terminal window where a command types itself after the prompt and the output lines appear one by one; use it to show a command being run.

name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: A horizontal timeline: a thin line strokes itself on, dots land at each step as it passes and labels settle beneath, with the last dot in the accent; use it for a sequence of steps or dates.

name: tracking-in
title: Tracking in
description: Wide letter-spacing collapses to normal while the line sharpens out of a light blur on a calm spring; use it for a title that lands.

name: underline
title: Underline
description: The text snaps in, then an accent line draws under it after a short beat; a two-step emphasis for one key phrase.

name: whip-pan
title: Whip pan
description: Both full-frame shots slide along one axis in about eight frames with a motion blur that follows the speed; use it to move between two parts of one screen or two screens on one ground (cut K7).

name: wipe
title: Wipe
description: A soft-edged wipe from one full-frame shot to the next, painted in the next shot's ground colour; use it between two busy scenes (cut K5).

name: zoom-through
title: Zoom through
description: The old shot pushes past the lens and blurs, a hard cut lands, and the new shot settles out of the same push from blur to sharp; use it when the video already uses blur (cut K4).

name: error-close
title: Close or delete icon | Error icon

name: bulb-bg
title: BulbBg
description: Rising dome with a soft blurred halo over a warm dark canvas. Loops continuously or sinks down / grows up as an exit beat.

name: cascading-text
title: Cascading text
description: Words enter from the right with a slow fast slow ease, drift left continuously, and the camera zooms out in distinct beats so longer sentences stay readable.

name: curvable-types
title: CurvableTypes
description: The first word zooms in from huge and blurred, settles at canvas center, and slides right while trailing words slide in. Per letter cascade or per word reveal.

name: ellipse-bloom
title: EllipseBloom
description: A two layer ellipse blooms from a pinhead to fill the frame in well under a second. Inner highlight is the primary, outer ring is a derived darker shade.

name: paste-pill
title: PastePill
description: Word spring sentence reveal with a shining gradient pill on the matched word. A 3D cursor flies up from below, dips on click, and the pill swaps to a grey active label.

name: slide-reveal
title: Slide reveal
description: Sentence slides off screen left while each word lifts in from below. Words appear in the accent color and ease to the text color.

name: text-hover
title: TextHover
description: Feathered light bar sweeps across bold outline text, revealing a gradient fill as it passes. Always rainbow or sweep to mono, with 2 to 5 color stops.

name: text-swap
title: Text swap
description: Two word swap. Letters from word 1 flash in the brand primary then disappear in random pairs while word 2 settles in their place. Letters never collide.

name: two-drops-bg
title: TwoDropsBg
description: Two teardrops glide on opposite sides of a rounded perimeter, glow spilling into the corners. Five derived shades from one primary color.

name: typewriter
title: Typewriter
description: Each character is born in the accent color and fades to the resting color, with a caret that stays flush against the latest glyph. Bar or block caret. Smooth or hard fade.

name: audio-clip
title: Audio clip
description: The workhorse audio primitive — a single file with agent-friendly trim (`startAt` / `endAt` accept `"0:04"` / `"30s"`), opt-in fade envelope, optional looping, and a dB-or-amplitude volume contract. Wraps Remotion's `<Html5Audio>`. Use for music beds, voiceover, and SFX equally.

name: audio-visualizer
title: Audio visualizer
description: Renders animated bars (frequency-domain) or a waveform (time-domain) for an audio file. Does **not** play audio — pair with a parallel `AudioClip` for playback. Uses `useAudioData` from `@remotion/media-utils` (cached per `src`).

name: bar-chart
title: Bar chart
description: Horizontal bars that grow from 0 to their value on SPRING_SMOOTH, staggered. Single-accent palette: the largest bar earns the dusty-rose accent, every other bar sits in --onda-dim. Calm, no overshoot, one focal moment.

name: bento-grid
title: Bento grid
description: A data-driven bento layout — a CSS grid of glass Surface cards with varying column/row spans. Each cell rises and fades in on the house spring, staggered left-to-right so the grid assembles as one calm cascade. One earned-accent cell max.

name: blur
title: Blur
description: Outgoing scene blurs out as it fades; incoming scene blurs in as it fades up. Extends the BlurReveal entrance fingerprint across a cut. Onda-original.

name: bounding-box
title: Bounding box
description: A UI annotation bounding box — a rectangle outline that strokes itself on like a selection marquee around a region, with optional corner ticks and an optional label tag pinned to the top-left corner. For highlighting a UI element in docs and tutorial videos; the accent is earned here.

name: browser-frame
title: Browser frame
description: A browser chrome that wraps arbitrary content — children, an image src, or a neutral placeholder. A container component (the documented exception to self-contained). Scales-and-fades in on the house spring.

name: button
title: Button
description: A CTA pill button — accent-filled (primary) or bordered (ghost). It fades and rises in on the house entrance, then plays an optional deterministic click-dip at pressFrame: a quick scale down to 0.94 and back that reads as a press.

name: captions
title: Captions
description: Sequential word-by-word captions driven by a timed array. The active word lifts in --onda-text with a subtle SPRING_SMOOTH scale pulse; surrounding words sit dim in --onda-dim. The data primitive for kinetic transcripts and AI-generated voiceover.

name: chapter-card
title: Chapter card
description: Chapter-title scene block with a numbered eyebrow ('01 The setup'). The number fades in first in accent rose, the chapter title rises with a calm blur-reveal, and an optional accent underline punctuates the title. Composes FadeIn, BlurReveal, and Underline.

name: chromatic-aberration
title: Chromatic aberration
description: The cut tears into red/cyan channels and snaps back — outgoing scene splits wider as it fades, incoming converges from a split. The catalog's most aggressive transition; a punctuation move, not a default. Onda-original.

name: clock-wipe
title: Clock wipe
description: A clock-hand wipe — the boundary between scenes rotates around the canvas center like a sweeping clock hand. Requires `width` + `height` (pass from `useVideoConfig()`). Wraps Remotion's `clockWipe()`.

name: code-diff
title: Code diff
description: A unified code diff on the Onda glass surface, revealed line-by-line. Added/removed lines carry a colored left border + gutter symbol; context lines stay neutral. Deterministic, no async highlighting.

name: confetti
title: Confetti
description: A celebratory confetti burst — pieces launch from an origin, fan outward, arc under gravity, tumble, and fade. Every per-piece value is seeded, so the same seed renders identically every time. Full-canvas layer; energetic but tasteful.

name: count-up
title: Count up
description: An animated number that counts from `from` to `to` on SPRING_SMOOTH while fading in. Tabular numerals keep digit widths fixed; locale-grouped (en-US) by default. Prefix and suffix support currency, units, and percentages.

name: cross-fade
title: Cross fade
description: A calm opacity cross-fade between two scenes — Onda's house easing (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) and 18-frame duration baked into the recommended timing call. Reads as deliberate, not generic. Wraps Remotion's `fade()` presentation.

name: cursor
title: Cursor
description: An animated pointer that travels between two canvas points on the house spring and emits a single restrained click ripple on arrival. A full-canvas layer for product and dev demos.

name: depth-push
title: Depth push
description: Push with parallax depth scale — outgoing scene scales down as it pushes off, incoming scales from slightly larger. The catalog's signature multi-scene move; reads as a camera dolly between scenes. Onda-original.

name: device-frame
title: Device frame
description: A phone or laptop bezel that wraps arbitrary content — children, an image src, or empty. A container component; scales-and-fades in on the house spring.

name: dip-to-color
title: Dip to color
description: The editing-room classic — outgoing scene fades to a solid color, incoming fades up from it. Default color is `--onda-bg` (`#08080A`) for brand consistency; pass `'#000'` for dip-to-black or `'#fff'` for dip-to-white. Onda-original.

name: draw-on
title: Draw on
description: An SVG path that strokes itself in — the substrate for logos, icons, and signature flourishes. Powered by @remotion/paths's evolvePath, driven by SPRING_SMOOTH. No overshoot.

name: end-card
title: End card
description: Closing scene block: a hero CTA reveals with an optional accent underline, then a faint, staggered row of social handles or URLs fades in beneath it. Composes BlurReveal, Underline, and StaggerGroup so the motion fingerprint stays consistent with the rest of the catalog.

name: fade-in
title: Fade in
description: A pure opacity fade for text — no movement, no scale, no blur. The simplest possible reveal.

name: fade-out
title: Fade out
description: The inverse of FadeIn: a pure opacity exit. Opacity travels from 1 to 0 on HOUSE_EASE, with no transform or blur. Slightly faster than entrances so the moment ends without lingering.

name: flip
title: Flip
description: A 3D card-flip between two scenes — outgoing rotates away, incoming rotates into view. Onda's directional vocabulary (`left` / `right` / `up` / `down`) with adjustable `perspective`. Wraps Remotion's `flip()`.

name: glass-wipe
title: Glass wipe
description: The incoming scene wipes in from a direction behind a frosted-glass edge that sharpens as it settles, while the outgoing scene frosts over beneath it. Calmer than a hard wipe, more textured than a cross-fade. Onda-original.

name: gradient-shift
title: Gradient shift
description: A quiet, drifting two-color linear gradient background. The angle rotates at a constant degrees-per-frame — linear-by-design, no spring. Low-saturation defaults (--onda-surface to --onda-border) keep it atmospheric, never focal.

name: grain-overlay
title: Grain overlay
description: A subtle film-grain layer overlaid on the canvas — pure SVG fractal noise, no text, no motion. The first atmospheric Onda primitive: texture only, restrained at ~2-4% opacity per the design tokens. Deterministic and self-contained, no external assets.

name: highlight
title: Highlight
description: Text fades in, then an accent-rose highlight bar slides in behind it at full text-height — a marker-style reveal. One of the catalog's rare earned-color moments, reserved for emphasis.

name: icon-pop
title: Icon pop
description: A small state icon — check, cross, dot, or star — that pops into place on SPRING_SMOOTH via entryScale (scale 0 → 1 plus opacity fade). Universal state primitive; the accent is earned.

name: image-reveal
title: Image reveal
description: An image that enters with one of Onda's signature motion fingerprints — blur falloff, fade, or subtle scale. Wraps Remotion's `` with `SPRING_SMOOTH` motion, no overshoot. Fills the canvas by default; pass `placement` to position as a sub-canvas element.

name: input-field
title: Input field
description: A rounded glass text input on the Onda Surface, with an optional label above and a placeholder. With `typed` on, the value types itself in (via useTextReveal) behind a blinking caret, with an accent focus ring — all frame-driven and deterministic.

name: iris
title: Iris
description: A circular reveal that grows from / collapses toward the canvas center, like a camera shutter opening. Requires `width` + `height` (pass from `useVideoConfig()`). Wraps Remotion's `iris()`.

name: kanban-board
title: Kanban board
description: A data-driven Kanban board — glass Surface columns with a header, status dot, ticket count, and a stack of small glass ticket cards. Cards rise + fade in on the house spring, staggered across the whole board so it assembles as one calm cascade.

name: logo-sting
title: Logo sting
description: Silent, restrained branded reveal: an SVG logo stroke draws in, a title settles beneath it, and a single accent underline lands last. A scene block composed strictly from DrawOn, ScaleIn, and Underline — no particles, no streaks, no flourish.

name: lower-third
title: Lower third
description: Broadcast-style name + role bar that slides in from the corner with a single accent underline. A restrained scene block composed from SlideIn, FadeIn, and Underline — no chrome, no glow, one earned accent.

name: matrix-decode
title: Matrix decode
description: Each character flickers through random glyphs, then settles to its target left-to-right — a decode reveal. The flicker is deterministic (seeded PRNG keyed by char index + frame), so it renders identically every time.

name: morph
title: Morph
description: Cross-fade plus a subtle synchronized scale (outgoing 1 → 1.04, incoming 0.96 → 1). Small enough to register as polish, not effect. The defining 'premium feel' transition in the Onda catalog. Onda-original.

name: node-graph
title: Node graph
description: A hub-and-spoke constellation: a labeled central hub with satellite nodes that fly in from off-frame, then settle into elliptical orbits at varying radii and speeds. Connection lines hub→satellite periodically light up. All motion is a deterministic, frame-driven, seeded function (§1).

name: parallax
title: Parallax
description: Slow horizontal or vertical drift over an image — a lighter, no-zoom complement to KenBurns. Intentionally linear for a constant, calm passage. Built for backgrounds and b-roll.

name: pricing-card
title: Pricing card
description: A single pricing tier on the Onda glass Surface — tier name, a large price, billing period, an accent-checkmark feature list, and a CTA button. Rises in on the house spring; set recommended to lift + scale it and add an accent badge + glow. One card; the consumer arranges three.

name: progress-steps
title: Progress steps
description: A horizontal stepper whose fill animates to the current step on the house spring. Completed dots and the connecting track carry the earned accent; the active step gets a soft glow ring; pending steps stay neutral.

name: pulsing-indicator
title: Pulsing indicator
description: A live status dot with a calm expanding-ring pulse and an optional label. The pulse is keyed off frame modulo so it loops seamlessly and renders deterministically — one steady ring, not a strobe.

name: push
title: Push
description: A directional push between two scenes — both translate together in the same direction, like a camera pan. Onda-original; different from `slide` (only incoming moves) and `depthPush` (adds parallax scale).

name: quote-card
title: Quote card
description: A centered pull-quote scene block with attribution. The quote reveals word-by-word with a slower-than-canonical stagger so the line reads rather than cascades; after a settled beat a small accent-rose rule draws in beneath it, then the author and role fade in together. Built for testimonials, documentary citations, and editorial-feeling section breaks.

name: scale-in
title: Scale in
description: A subtle scale-from-slightly-smaller-and-fade entrance. No overshoot, no scale jumps — restrained on purpose.

name: skeleton-card
title: Skeleton card
description: A loading-placeholder card — a glass Surface with an optional thumbnail block and a stack of text bars, swept by a frame-driven shimmer band. The 'still generating / not loaded yet' state before content populates. Rises in on the house spring; the shimmer loops so the placeholder feels live.

name: slide
title: Slide
description: A directional slide between two scenes — only the incoming scene translates, the outgoing stays in place. Wraps Remotion's `slide()` with Onda's directional vocabulary (`left` / `right` / `up` / `down`). Pair with the recommended Onda timing for the house feel.

name: slide-in
title: Slide in
description: A direction-parameterized translate-and-fade entrance — text slides into place from up, down, left, or right on the house spring. No overshoot, calm 16px travel.

name: slide-out
title: Slide out
description: A direction-parameterized translate-and-fade exit — text drifts up, down, left, or right while opacity fades to 0 on the house spring. The mirror of SlideIn. No overshoot, calm 16px travel.

name: slot-machine-roll
title: Slot machine roll
description: Each character spins down a reel of glyphs and lands on its target, settling on the house spring, staggered left-to-right. Filler glyphs are seeded (deterministic). Best on short numeric strings.

name: split-screen
title: Split screen
description: A two-pane split layout — left and right content panes (any JSX) divided by a thin token line. A container that wraps arbitrary content; the two panes slide in from their outer edges on the house spring.

name: spotlight-card
title: Spotlight card
description: A glass card with a spotlight that drifts slowly behind the content (Surface + a frame-driven Glow). The card rises in on the house spring while the spotlight keeps moving — alive, not busy.

name: stagger-group
title: Stagger group
description: A composition primitive that reveals a list of items in sequence using the canonical Onda stagger (4 frames between siblings). The foundation pattern for animated lists, bullet build-ons, feature reveals, and any sequenced text reveal. Demonstrates the signature stagger fingerprint in its purest form.

name: text-fade-replace
title: Text fade replace
description: Cycles through a list of phrases, crossfading one into the next in place so the swap never shifts the layout. Calm house-eased crossfade for rotating taglines and value props.

name: title-card
title: Title card
description: Hero title-card scene block: a large headline reveals with a calm blur-and-rise, a subtitle cascades word-by-word beneath it, and an optional accent underline arrives last as quiet punctuation. Composes BlurReveal / Underline and WordStagger — no new motion of its own.

name: tracking-in
title: Tracking in
description: Text begins spread wide and contracts to its resting letter-spacing on the house spring, fading and sharpening from a soft blur as it settles. A cinematic title entrance with no overshoot.

name: type-mask
title: Type mask
description: A giant word holds, then scales up exponentially until the negative space inside its letters blows past the screen edges — revealing the incoming scene through the type. A kinetic typographic mask. Onda-original.

name: typewriter
title: Typewriter
description: Character-by-character text reveal with an optional blinking cursor in the Onda accent. Linear pacing by design — the one intentional exception to the house spring rule, because typing has its own constant rhythm.

name: video-clip
title: Video clip
description: A video clip with agent-friendly trim (`startAt` / `endAt` accept `"0:04"` / `"30s"`), Onda's entrance and exit fade fingerprint, and optional looping.
